description: A linear Qubit passed twice to the same form (cons q q) is a no-cloning violation and must be rejected under --strict-types (same shape as tests/typesystem/qubit_no_cloning_test.esk). Under default/gradual mode this is only a warning and the program is allowed to proceed to codegen, so this case pins the --strict-types fatal contract specifically.

diagnostics.contains: linear variable 'q' was consumed more than once
